posts.name: Saptadev Chatterjee
posts.cooked: same problem i just did the setup for oppe vm and now i cannot access the course vm

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: This is happening as you have generated a new key so your old key was lost and connection couldn’t be established. If you have generated new key that means your OPPE vm will also show the same, if you have done today. Please submit the new key in the OPPE as well as course vm. If you are getting email doesn’t exists either you are submitting your key in the wrong portal or just do it twice,(the second time you submit this error goes away) you will get the access.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: Just submit your existing key in the course vm. Do not do ssh-keygen again or you will lose access to oppe vm.

posts.name: Saptadev Chatterjee
posts.cooked: but i generated the course vm key again, so according to you i have lost the oppe access, so should i again do the keygen for oppe?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
No, you shouldn’t again & again do ssh-keygen.

Just do
cd .ssh
ls
there you will see either id_ed25519.pub or id_rsa.pub based on the file you see do -
cat id_ed25519.pub
or
cat id_rsa.pub
then copy (but don’t use notepad.exe it copies extra characters → directly copy from terminal)

Paste it to both course vm portal and oppe portal.

You will not be able to access oppe vm now, it will open at 5 pm.
